pairsWith.noteUz: 11-12-unitlar (Our Precious Planet, Holidays with a Difference) bo'yicha nazorat testi: 2-tur shart gap (would/if), nisbiy olmoshlar (who/which/where), atrof-muhit, sayohat va mehmonxona so'zlari, taklif qilish.

scanNote:
PROGRESS TEST 6 - Units 11-12 (79-bet, PDF 70). Yuqorida to'q sariq 'PROGRESS TEST 6' va 'Units 11-12'. Katakchalar: NAME, CLASS, DATE, MARK, (Time: 20 minutes).

'Vocabulary & Grammar':
1) 'Fill in the missing words.' 1 On a sunny day I ...... prefer to go to the sea. 2 What would you do ...... you won £1,000? 3 It's boiling ...... outside. 4 He went to Rio ...... he met his wife. 5 Jamaica is an ...... place for summer holidays. 6 This lake is ...... . You can swim in it. 7 We look ...... to seeing you on the 3rd of August. 8 Our room had a fantastic ...... of the sea. 9 There was such ...... traffic that he was late for work. 10 We ...... go to the zoo if you'd like. 11 Do you know ...... by the name of James Smith? 12 He does ...... but play computer games all day. 13 The hotel provides guests with warm ...... bags. 14 I'm not really in the ...... for going out tonight. 15 Let's ...... dinner together, shall we? 16 We should take ...... of our planet before it's too late. 17 "Could you please tell me your ......?" "Ann Tims." 18 We can't live ...... water and air. 19 I want to make a cake, but I haven't got ...... flour. 20 "How ...... will that be?" "£70 per night."
2) 'Choose the correct item.' 1 Are there any meals ...... in the price? A reserved B booked C included. 2 Naples is on the west ...... of Italy. A heart B coast C shore. 3 Venice is ...... in the north-east of Italy. A stretched B located C met. 4 A key is something ...... opens doors. A which B who C where. 5 Pandas are a(n) ...... species. A basic B endangered C leaking. 6 The government should ...... a law to ban cars from city centres. A make B pass C create. 7 A nurse is someone ...... looks after sick people. A where B which C who. 8 Air pollution causes ...... rain. A acid B public C rare. 9 You look very tired. You ...... to work less hours. A ought B should C must. 10 Car fumes ...... the air. A survive B waste C pollute.

'Communication':
3) 'Complete the dialogues.' 1 A: Aston Hotel. How can ......? B: Hello. I'd like to book a room for two, please. 2 A: Shall we go out tonight? B: ......, but I can't. I'm working late. 3 A: I can't lose weight. B: If ......, I'd walk to work. 4 A: ...... going to the cinema on Sunday? B: That would be lovely. 5 A: What shall we do this weekend? B: ...... go to the beach?

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '79'.

exercises.explanationUz:
11-12-UNITLAR TAKRORI - 20 ta
  bo'shliq.

  2-TUR ShART GAP: I WOULD prefer;
    What would you do IF you won?;
    We COULD go to the zoo
  NISBIY: went to Rio WHERE he met;
    Do you know ANYONE by the name
    of ...?
  SAYOHAT: boiling HOT; an IDEAL
    place; the lake is CLEAN; look
    FORWARD to; a fantastic VIEW;
    such HEAVY traffic; warm
    SLEEPING bags; How MUCH will
    that be?; tell me your NAME
  ATROF-MUHIT: take CARE of our
    planet; can't live WITHOUT
    water
  Boshqa: does NOTHING but play;
    in the MOOD for; Let's HAVE
    dinner; haven't got ANY /
    ENOUGH flour


⚠ 'BOILING HOT':

  = qaynoq issiq.


⚠ 'IN THE MOOD FOR':

  = ... ga kayfiyati bor.

items.textEn: On a sunny day I ___ prefer to go to the sea.
What would you do ___ you won £1,000?
It's boiling ___ outside.
He went to Rio ___ he met his wife.
Jamaica is an ___ place for summer holidays.
This lake is ___. You can swim in it.
We look ___ to seeing you on the 3rd of August.
Our room had a fantastic ___ of the sea.
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'a view of the sea' = dengiz manzarasi.

items.textEn: There was such ___ traffic that he was late for work.
We ___ go to the zoo if you'd like.
Do you know ___ by the name of James Smith?
He does ___ but play computer games all day.
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'does nothing but' = ... dan boshqa hech narsa qilmaydi.

items.textEn: The hotel provides guests with warm ___ bags.
I'm not really in the ___ for going out tonight.
Let's ___ dinner together, shall we?
We should take ___ of our planet before it's too late.
"Could you please tell me your ___?" "Ann Tims."
We can't live ___ water and air.
I want to make a cake, but I haven't got ___ flour.
"How ___ will that be?" "£70 per night."

exercises.explanationUz:
11-12-UNITLAR LUG'ATI VA
  GRAMMATIKASI.

  1 meals INCLUDED in the price
  2 the west COAST of Italy
  3 Venice is LOCATED in
  4 something WHICH opens (narsa)
  5 an ENDANGERED species = yo'qolib
    borayotgan tur
  6 PASS a law = qonun qabul qilmoq
  7 someone WHO looks after (odam)
  8 ACID rain = kislotali yomg'ir
  9 You OUGHT to work less
    ('ought TO' - 'to' bor!)
  10 Car fumes POLLUTE the air


⚠ 'COAST' va 'SHORE':

  coast = qirg'oq (mamlakat
  miqyosida); shore = qirg'oq bo'yi
  (suv yaqini).

items.textEn: Are there any meals ___ in the price?
Naples is on the west ___ of Italy.
Venice is ___ in the north-east of Italy.
A key is something ___ opens doors.
Pandas are a(n) ___ species.
The government should ___ a law to ban cars from city centres.
items.uz: Hukumat shahar markazlarida mashinalarni taqiqlovchi qonun qabul qilishi kerak.

items.textEn: A nurse is someone ___ looks after sick people.
Air pollution causes ___ rain.
items.uz: Havo ifloslanishi kislotali yomg'irga sabab bo'ladi.

items.textEn: You look very tired. You ___ to work less hours.
items.uz: Juda charchagan ko'rinasiz. Kamroq ishlashingiz kerak.

items.textEn: Car fumes ___ the air.

exercises.explanationUz:
MEHMONXONA, TAKLIF, MASLAHAT
  DIALOGLARI.

  1 Telefon → How can I HELP YOU?
  2 Taklifni rad etish → I'D LOVE
    TO, but I can't.
  3 Maslahat → If I WERE YOU, I'd
    walk to work.
  4 Taklif → HOW/WHAT ABOUT going
    to the cinema?
  5 Taklif → WHY DON'T WE / SHALL
    WE go to the beach?


⚠ 'IF I WERE YOU':

  = sizning o'rningizda bo'lsam
  ('was' emas, 'WERE').


⚠ 'TO LOSE WEIGHT':

  = ozmoq.

items.textEn: A: Aston Hotel. How can ___?  B: Hello. I'd like to book a room for two, please.
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'How can I help you?' - telefonga javob.

items.textEn: A: Shall we go out tonight?  B: ___, but I can't. I'm working late.
A: I can't lose weight.  B: If ___, I'd walk to work.
A: ___ going to the cinema on Sunday?  B: That would be lovely.
A: What shall we do this weekend?  B: ___ go to the beach?

patterns.formula: If + KIM + O'TGAN ZAMON, KIM + would + FE'L
patterns.exampleEn: What would you do if you won £1,000? If I were you, I'd walk to work.
patterns.exampleUz: 1000 funt yutsang nima qilarding? Sening o'rningda bo'lsam, ishga piyoda borardim.

patterns.exampleEn: A nurse is someone who looks after sick people. A key is something which opens doors.
patterns.exampleUz: Hamshira - kasallarga qaraydigan odam. Kalit - eshiklarni ochadigan narsa.

patterns.formula: How about + -ing? / Why don't we + FE'L? / Shall we + FE'L?
patterns.exampleEn: How about going to the cinema on Sunday? - That would be lovely.
patterns.exampleUz: Yakshanba kinoga borsak-chi? - Juda yaxshi bo'lardi.

patterns.exampleEn: You ought to work less hours. We should take care of our planet.
patterns.exampleUz: Kamroq ishlashingiz kerak. Sayyoramizga g'amxo'rlik qilishimiz kerak.
